summary: Frontend end-to-end validation of Bar Partenaire Officiel (-10%) PHASE 1. All 5 scenarios pass: (1) admin partner screen renders configured bar 'Péniche Marcounet' with stats (1 émis / 1 utilisé), code NFUTG7X, QR image, deep link, copy-code row, active switch; club search 'Rex' returns 2 results without re-selecting; (2) redeem NF-ZZZZZZ shows no crash and admin screen stays intact (Alert on RN Web does not surface as a DOM dialog so alert text cannot be asserted, but backend rejects code and UI recovers cleanly); (3) reviewer 'Mes avantages' shows 1 coupon Péniche Marcounet NF-GU4B29 status 'Utilisé' 14/08/2026 with working back button; (4) registration with partner code NFUTG7X for fresh account (nftest_x1iz0wyh@nightfinder.app, DOB 15/05/1995) lands on Home and 🎉 unlock modal 'Offre débloquée !' appears with -10% Péniche Marcounet + code NF-MBUOB3; 'Voir mes avantages' navigates to /advantages showing the coupon with 'Disponible' status; (5) regression: Home renders club cards (FlatList virtualization; ~99 total loaded from API, first batch shown), search filters correctly (Rex → 1 card), Plus tab and /admin display without crashes. Partner switch left ACTIVE.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: Alert.alert on RN Web does not surface as native window dialog for testing tools. Consider replacing critical admin Alerts (redeem success/failure) with an in-app toast/banner that has a testID so future automation can assert copy like 'Coupon introuvable'.
critical_code_review_comments: admin-partner.tsx: BASE_URL falls back to '' if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL missing → QR image src becomes '/api/partner/qr' which still works on same-origin web but breaks native. Currently OK since env is set.
partner.ts claimPendingPartnerCode only clears pending code on 400/404, so any transient 5xx keeps retrying on every Home mount. Acceptable for now.

Home (index.tsx) triggers capture+claim inside the top useEffect with no dependency on auth-ready state. In our test the Home was reached only after login so claim worked, but on cold start with lingering token a race could theoretically call /api/partner/claim before axios has the JWT set. Consider gating on `user` from useAuth.
